translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses and Aaron directly.
translations.2: This is the statute of the law which God commanded, saying: 'Instruct the sons of Israel that they bring you a yellow cow, sound, in which there is no blemish, upon which no yoke has come up.'
translations.3: 'And deliver her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her out to outside the camp, and he shall slaughter her in his presence.'
translations.4: 'And he shall take of her blood with his finger, and shall sprinkle, facing the entrance of the tent of the appointed meeting, from it, seven times.'
translations.5: 'And he shall give the order that she be burned in his presence, with her hide and her flesh, and her blood and her dung.'
translations.6: 'And the priest shall take a cedar-wood staff, and hyssop, and scarlet dye, and shall cast these into the midst of her burning.'
translations.7: 'And this priest shall wash his garments, and shall rinse his body with water; and after that he shall enter into the camp, and he shall be impure until the evening.'
translations.8: 'And he who burns her shall wash his garments, and shall rinse his body with water, and shall be impure until sunset.'
translations.9: 'And a ritually pure man shall gather the ashes of the cow, and shall place them outside the camp in a pure place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the sons of Israel, for the water of sprinkling — it is a purification-offering.'
translations.10: 'And he who gathers her ashes shall wash his garments, and shall be impure until the evening.' And it shall be for the sons of Israel, and for the stranger who dwells among them, a perpetual statute forever.
translations.11: And whoever approaches a dead person from among all the souls of mankind shall be impure for seven days.
translations.12: He shall purify himself from it on the third day and the seventh day, and then he shall be pure; but if he does not purify himself from it on both of them, he shall not be pure.
translations.13: So every one who approaches a dead person from among the souls of mankind who dies, and does not purify himself — he has defiled the dwelling of God when he entered it; and that person shall be cut off from the house of Israel, since the water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, and he is therefore impure, and his impurity remains upon him always.
translations.14: And this is the law: any person who dies in a tent — all that is in it and all who enter into it shall be impure for seven days.
translations.15: And every open earthenware vessel that has no stopper fastened upon it is impure.
translations.16: And every one who approaches upon the face of the wilderness — one slain by the sword, or a dead person, or a human bone, or a grave — shall be impure for seven days.
translations.17: And there shall be taken for him some of the ashes of the burning of the cow, and spring water shall be poured over it into a vessel.
translations.18: And a ritually pure man shall take some hyssop, and dip it in that water, and shall sprinkle upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons who were there, and upon the one who drew near to a bone, or to the slain, or to the dead, or to the grave.
translations.19: So the pure man shall sprinkle upon the impure on the third day and the seventh day; and when he has purified him on the seventh day, he shall wash his garments and rinse himself with water, and shall be pure at evening.
translations.20: But any man who has become impure by this and has not purified himself — that person shall be cut off from among the assembly, since he has defiled the sanctuary of God when he entered it, and the water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him; he is impure.
translations.21: And this shall be for them a perpetual statute forever. And the one who sprinkles the water of sprinkling shall wash his garments; and whoever touches the water of sprinkling shall be impure until the evening.
translations.22: And whatever the impure person touches shall become impure; and if a person approached it, he shall be impure until the evening.
